title: Dolmens tied to a cult of giants

tellings.quote: Um and I believe that the dolmans are associated with the giants, not just because they're large stones, but they're associated with the cult of giants.

plain: Dolmens, the ancient stone structures made of big upright slabs topped by a flat capstone and found in places like Sardinia and Minorca, were linked to a cult that worshipped giants, according to the researcher Tim Alberino. He gives this as his own belief, without naming a source, and says the link is "not just because they're large stones, but they're associated with the cult of giants." If he is right, these monuments would be traces of an old giant cult spread across Europe.
